metadata.title: Talazoparib Therapy
metadata.indication: Monotherapy for adults with germline BRCA1/2-mutated, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer following appropriate prior anthracycline/taxane and endocrine therapy where relevant.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

source_supplements.title: EMA Talzenna product information
source_supplements.scope: Breast monotherapy; formulation, organ function, interactions and unresolved NCCP/SmPC differences

metadata.schedule_summary: Talazoparib is taken once daily continuously until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The usual starting dose is 1 mg; kidney function, interactions and side effects can require a different prescription.
source_boundaries: Renal selector was previously <15 versus ≥15 only; four correct CrCl intervals are now reachable through numeric entry. EMA specifies 15≤CrCl<30 and 30≤CrCl<60.
Renal doses are recommended starting doses; toxicity reduction and P-gp interaction adjustments depend on current history.
The source does not require dose reduction for mild, moderate or severe hepatic impairment in breast monotherapy. Prostate combination dosing must not be imported.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source. It does not replace the current NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review or pharmacy verification.

indications.description: Talazoparib monotherapy for germline BRCA1/2-mutated HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.

administration.notes: Talazoparib 1 mg orally once daily continuously until progression or unacceptable toxicity; renal function, interactions and toxicity may require a lower prescription. The 28-day display is a review block, not a tablet-free interval.

renal_input.reason: Continuous entry preserves the source renal thresholds; EMA defines the exact half-open CrCl bands and clarifies the severe-impairment limitations.

supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT
summary: No routine premedication specified by NCCP.
Monitor FBC monthly and provide transfusion or growth-factor support when clinically appropriate.
supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP oral classification v6 Table 8: minimal-to-low; Table 5 supports PRN antiemetics.
regimen_specific_notes: No routine premedication; symptom-led antiemetics under the oral minimal/low plan.
FBC, renal and liver profile at baseline and every four weeks or as indicated.
Swallow capsules whole, with or without food. Do not replace a missed or vomited dose.
Female contraception during treatment and seven months afterwards; male contraception four months afterwards; breastfeeding excluded during treatment and for at least one month after.
